blocks.label: Overview
paragraphs: A Deliciously Simple Way to Fuel Your Go.

Cut through life's chaos with Rise, your body's fuel for a straightforward, clean boost. Power up with 100% real, simple ingredients packed with protein-no fillers, nothing artificial, ever. Fuel your body's journey with Rise, featuring the added benefit of whey protein sourced from the milk of grass-fed cows. It's a great choice for your active lifestyle before or after exercise, between meals, or any time of day when you need extra protein. Let's rise together.

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: Mix two level scoops with 8 oz of cold water or your favorite milk into a shaker bottle. Shake until protein powder becomes fully dissolved & enjoy!

blocks.label: Other ingredients
paragraphs: Whey protein concentrate, organic cocoa, organic coconut milk powder, sunflower lecithin, natural flavors, sea salt, almond butter, organic monk fruit extract.
Produced on equipment that also processes eggs, wheat and soy.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Store in a cool dry place. Keep out of direct sunlight. Texture may vary due to natural ingredients.
​Use this product as a food supplement only. Do not use for weight reduction.
